providers.name: Sofia Marchetti
providers.bio: Sofia has 12 years behind the chair and specializes in dimensional color and balayage. She trained in Milan and loves helping clients transition to lower-maintenance color.

providers.name: Marcus Reid
providers.bio: Marcus specializes in precision men's cuts and modern fades, plus quick blowouts for clients on the go. Known for a relaxed chair-side manner and always running on time.

providers.name: Priya Nair
providers.bio: Priya is certified in gel and dip powder application and has a steady hand for nail art. Clients love her attention to cuticle care and relaxing hand massage finish.

providers.name: Elena Vasquez
providers.bio: Elena focuses on customized facials for sensitive and acne-prone skin, and is certified in both hard and soft wax techniques. She keeps a skincare routine simple and sustainable for every client.

providers.name: David Okonkwo
providers.bio: David is a licensed massage therapist with a background in sports recovery. He blends Swedish and deep-tissue techniques based on what each client's body needs that day.
